question: In the Commonwealth Games, 2022, India won _________ .
solution:
The correct answer is __**22 gold medals**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Commonwealth Games 2022 Location:**

 
 
• The 2022 Commonwealth Games were held in Birmingham, England, from July 28 to August 8, 2022.
 
 
 
• **India's Overall Performance:**
 
 
• India had a very successful campaign, finishing fourth in the overall medal tally.
 
• India won a total of 61 medals.
 
• This total medal count consisted of 22 gold medals, 16 silver medals, and 23 bronze medals.
 
 
 
• **Gold Medal Breakdown:**
 
 
• India's 22 gold medals came from various sports, showcasing the country's diverse sporting talent.
 
• Wrestling was a particularly strong sport for India, with several gold medals won.
 
• Weightlifting was another sport where India excelled, securing multiple gold medals.
 
• Badminton also contributed to the gold medal count.
 
• Table tennis also provided gold medals for India.
 
• Lawn bowls also provided India with a gold medal.
 
• Boxing also added to the gold medal count.
 
 
 
• **Notable Performances:**
 
 
• Indian athletes delivered numerous outstanding performances, capturing the attention of the nation.
 
• Many younger athletes showed great promise.
 
• The games showed the depth of talent within India.
